summary: Tightened the prose, restored the 'as of August 2026' status stamps and concluded-project dates, corrected imprecise or inflated claims (European Parliament citation, 'regularly served' at EACEA, Digit Srl's scope, 'informed public debate'), added omitted co-developers and dated details, and cut filler.

flags.claim: he shapes the next generation of researchers by teaching courses
flags.issue: Empty abstraction not supported by any source; the fact sheet only lists the courses he has taught. Removed in revision.

flags.claim: established and continues to direct the Mapping Italian News Research Program (MINE)
flags.issue: The authoritative biography stamps MINE's ongoing status 'as of August 2026' and says he has coordinated it; the biography turned this into a timeless present-tense claim and used 'direct' rather than 'coordinate'. Revised to restore the dated stamp.

flags.claim: has regularly served as an independent evaluator and rapporteur for the European Education and Culture Executive Agency
flags.issue: The authoritative biography records a single appointment as evaluator and rapporteur, running to September 2026 as of August 2026; 'regularly served' implies repeated service no source asserts. Revised to a single dated appointment.

A claim about third-party effects. Sources support only that the work drew named media coverage and was cited in a written question to the European Commission; 'informed public debate' goes beyond what the authoritative biography states. Replaced with the specific supported facts.

flags.claim: receiving formal citation in the European Parliament
flags.issue: Imprecise: the authoritative biography states the 2025 working paper was cited in a written question to the European Commission (European Parliament document E-10-2026-000086), not that Parliament formally cited it. Restated precisely.

flags.claim: dedicated to creating digital platforms for civic engagement and environmental sustainability
flags.issue: The fact sheet describes Digit Srl's platforms as for sustainability, civic participation, social innovation and scientific dissemination; 'environmental' is an added qualifier and two fields were dropped. Corrected.

flags.claim: This initiative has served as the primary framework for a series of externally funded investigations
flags.issue: The authoritative biography states all funded MINE sub-projects had concluded by February 2026 and that his professional memberships and MINE's active status hold 'as of August 2026'; the original omitted the concluded/ongoing distinction and the dated stamps. Restored in revision.

flags.claim: he co-developed CooRnet, an open-source R package
flags.issue: The original omitted co-developers Nicola Righetti and Luca Rossi, whom the authoritative biography names. Added.
